reviews.text: The owner answered my call and kindly informed me that he has cancer. He is battling with it for a year and a half. Keep it up, I am praying for you.
Very professional service and customer service at its finest.

After a really bad experience with maxi zoo groomers this place has really saved us and made arrangements that suited us. Made sure our pup was comfortable and did an amazing job. Would recommend to anyone as a first time groomer!
Delighted with my first visit to Dusty's Grooming. Very happy with the result
